title: Subcontract record
purpose: Review a completed external handoff, its selected containers, immutable source-result versions and independent acceptance history.

sections.title: Header and actions
paragraphs: All laboratory staff can read; portal accounts cannot. Source status considers the latest version, not a historical acceptance. Cancelled records retain their history.
When the latest source reports a unit other than the catalog unit, a Unit differs warning naming both units appears above the record. The source is still recorded and reported as supplied.

items.label: Subcontract / Source status / Client / Lab ID / Analyte / External laboratory
items.description: Identifies the route, latest source state and requested test; Lab ID links to the sample.

items.label: Cancel external dispatch
items.description: Receipt roles can cancel only an active dispatch with no source result history.

items.label: Enter external source result
items.description: Analysts, project managers and administrators can enter the first result for an active dispatch.

items.label: Correct external source
items.description: The same entry roles add a source version when one already exists. Earlier source data and attachments remain; each new version needs independent review.

items.label: Review external source
items.description: Reviewers/administrators can review the latest undecided source only if someone else entered it. The entry author cannot accept their own transcription.

items.label: External order reference
items.description: Actual external arrangement reference.

items.label: Sample ID at dispatch
items.description: ID known at handoff, or Not assigned at dispatch; later source identity is stored separately.

items.label: Completed handoff
items.description: Event timestamp, origin location and receiving custodian/courier.

items.label: Recorded by
items.description: Local recording actor and timestamp.

items.label: Cancellation
items.description: When present, cancellation actor/time/reason. It does not assert physical return of containers.

items.label: Container label / Description / Condition at receipt / Preservation
items.description: Snapshots of only the selected containers as recorded at dispatch. Other containers and the sample location are tracked separately in receipt/custody. No containers selected is an explicit empty state.

items.label: Latest / historical
items.description: Versions are ordered newest first. The latest observation is expanded. Show original observation and source review expands each historical version; corrections do not overwrite it.

items.label: No external result received
items.description: Enter the reported observation and source PDF when available; this state is different from an unreviewed result.

items.label: Exact reported result
items.description: Original reported text and unit; ND is preserved as non-detect rather than numeric zero.

items.label: Catalog unit
items.description: The unit of the requested catalog test, frozen with the source. An external source is transcribed exactly, so its reported unit can differ. When it does, this row shows Unit differs with the reported unit. The source is still recorded, reviewed and reported in the unit as supplied, and nothing is converted.

items.label: Reporting limit / dilution
items.description: Exact applied reporting limit in the reported unit and the external dilution; these are source facts, not catalog defaults.

items.label: External method and version
items.description: Method/version transcribed from the external report, which may differ from the catalog request.

items.label: External analyst / analysis time
items.description: Reported analyst and analysis start in laboratory local time.

items.label: External laboratory / sample ID
items.description: Frozen source identity, including actual external sample ID; not merely an ID tentatively known at dispatch.

items.label: External report reference
items.description: Reference identifying the supplied source report.

items.label: External qualifiers and meanings
items.description: Recorded qualifiers/explanations or None recorded.

items.label: Entered by
items.description: Local transcription actor and entry timestamp, separate from the external analyst.

items.label: Correction reason / source note
items.description: Reason for a new version or Initial external source entry when the first has no note.

items.label: Source PDF
items.description: Download staff-only source opens the exact attachment for this version. Size and SHA-256 identify stored bytes. The download verifies size/hash and refuses a corrupt file with a contact-the-laboratory error; it is unavailable to portal accounts.

items.label: Source review
items.description: Awaiting independent source review, or Accepted source/Rejected source with reviewer, time and note. Source acceptance is separate from internal analytical/QC approval.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological external handoff, cancellation, source-entry and source-review audit events with actor, time and reason/source note. Accepted source remains a provenance decision separate from internal analytical and QC approval; reporting uses the latest independently accepted source.
